purpose: Exact source-workbook to browser serialization correspondence; no prediction or endpoint admission

workbook.rows: Retain every row after the header with any nonblank A/B/C literal; count entirely blank formatted rows separately
workbook.parsing: Read OOXML directly with standard-library ZIP/XML readers; decode shared and inline strings; preserve numeric cached literals and flag formulas; require exact agreement with the authenticated prior literal-row artifact

matching: Exact literal (phage, derived Genotype, context) keys; no case/punctuation aliases. Keep every source row and every browser row-context. Only one-source/one-browser keys are comparable; duplicated keys on either side remain ambiguous without averaging or pairing guesses.

decimal_comparison.tolerance_purpose: Fixed serialization-rounding diagnostic, never an infection threshold
decimal_comparison.nonfinite_missing_or_uninterpreted: Preserve literals and report noncomparable; no zero substitution
decimal_comparison.transforms: None; no inverse logarithms, scaling, normalization or fitting

reporting: Report exact and tolerance counts separately, all value mismatches, unpaired/unrecognized rows and ambiguous keys. Bind inputs, policy, implementation and row-level artifacts before/after comparison.
admission: Correspondence alone does not authenticate stocks, censoring/LOD, assay conditions, complementation mechanism, functional infection or predictive validity. Initial literal audit remains unchanged and all rows remain unadmitted.
